description:
Two choropleth maps comparing different versions of Natura 2000 (N2K) site definitions for a specific French site, FR7200672, within a consistent Area of Interest (AoI).
The overall light orange shaded area in both maps represents the stable N2K Area of Interest (AoI), likely derived from a buffered N2K site selection, covering the same geographic extent in both views.
The map on the left shows the N2K site boundaries based on an earlier database version (e.g., Natura 2000 v2013), depicted as fewer, larger, and more contiguous light blue polygons, each labelled "FR7200672".
The map on the right shows the N2K site boundaries based on a later database version (e.g., Natura 2000 end2015), depicted as more numerous, smaller, and more fragmented light purple polygons, each also labelled "FR7200672".
This comparison illustrates that while the N2K Area of Interest (AoI) (the light orange buffer) remains stable for Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) products to facilitate change mapping, the underlying Natura 2000 site definitions (as governed by the Habitats Directive 92/43/EEC and Birds Directive 2009/147/EC) can change over time, leading to variations in the mapped protected area boundaries and fragmentation. No scale bar, compass, or legend are visible.
